title: Get paid to post - just install our creator app
scenario: A brand DM offers to pay you to post about their product, but first you need to install their 'creator app' from a link outside the app store to track your earnings.

answers.A: Install it, since it's just to track how much you're paid.
answers.B: Install it, and also share your login so they can 'verify' your account.
answers.C: Don't install anything outside the app store, and check whether the brand and offer are real before agreeing to anything.

explanation: Real brand partnerships pay through normal platforms and never require installing an app from outside the official store just to be paid.
proTip: A job offer that starts with installing an unknown app is the job.
